method: Expanding-window walk-forward by season. Models are refitted before each test season on all earlier seasons.
selection_reason: Lowest score log loss on the selection seasons: xg_lean. Chosen: xg_lean, the simplest candidate not significantly worse than it on score log loss or winner log loss.

baseline_home.description: Home-ice baseline: league-average scoring plus home advantage only.

elo_goals.description: Elo rating difference mapped to scoring rates.

scoring_avg.description: Historical scoring baseline: opponent-adjusted goals for and against.

xg_glm.description: Expected-goals Poisson model, confirmed starting goalies.

xg_glm_elo.description: Expected-goals Poisson model plus Elo rating.

xg_lean.description: Lean Poisson model: all-situations xG, goals, Elo, goaltending, rest.

ablate_xga.description: Lean model without the 'xga' feature group.

ablate_goals.description: Lean model without the 'goals' feature group.

ablate_elo.description: Lean model without the 'elo' feature group.

ablate_goalie.description: Lean model without the 'goalie' feature group.

ablate_rest.description: Lean model without the 'rest' feature group.

add_xg5.description: Lean model plus the 'xg5' feature group.

add_special.description: Lean model plus the 'special' feature group.

add_finishing.description: Lean model plus the 'finishing' feature group.

xg_lean_proj.description: Lean Poisson model, projected starting goalies (pre-confirmation).

blend.description: Log-linear blend of the Poisson model and gradient boosting.

xg_lean_cal.description: Lean Poisson model with spread calibration.

xg_glm_elo_cal.description: Expected-goals Poisson model plus Elo, with spread calibration.

elo_raw.description: Elo win probability used directly (winner metrics only).
